variants.label: Мандариновый глянец
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Precise brand-style variation of IMAGE 1, our current Telegram avatar. IMAGE 1 is the edit target and locks character, pose and composition. IMAGES 2-4 are style and color reference ONLY: our published orange emoji family. Create ONE standalone square avatar. Preserve the open refrigerator chef, visible tomatoes carrots greens and milk, white/cream chef toque, subtle small calm eyes and smile, and wooden cooking spoon held in character's anatomical RIGHT hand on the VIEWER'S LEFT. Door MUST stay open on VIEWER'S RIGHT. Do not mirror. Preserve mature miniature proportions and restrained expression; do not copy the emoji's huge anime eyes, wink, blush, eyelashes or open mouth. Adopt the emoji family's soft rounded sculpted 3D surfaces, warm light, cream highlights, tangerine orange, apricot, honey and caramel shadows. Remove all mint/cyan body trim. Ingredients may retain natural muted olive green and tomato red; milk packaging becomes warm cream with apricot accents. Wooden spoon stays visibly brown real wood. Dark charcoal studio background, no scene, no text, numbers, logo, frame or watermark, generous circular-avatar crop safety with every limb and spoon fully inside. Make this version visually distinct while keeping the same identity. Variant direction: Closest match to the shiny orange fridge and cloche emoji: rich saturated tangerine outer casing and doors, pale apricot handles, warm cream interior, creamy fabric toque with orange band, glossy smooth rounded enamel with broad soft cream reflections. Premium manufactured miniature; high contrast orange shell against cream hat.
